Persistence is requested only after the first successful case creation and cached once per PersistenceClient.

StorageStatus exposes a backupAction slot but does not implement backup export/import, which remains out of scope.

payload.taskDescription: Implement persistence helpers that call navigator.storage.persist() on first case creation, report persistent or best-effort, and read navigator.storage.estimate(). Add a StorageStatus component to the shelf showing state, usage, quota, and an 80 percent warning. Add a BroadcastChannel-based useBroadcastSync hook that broadcasts case mutation events and invalidates shelf and case reads in other tabs without replacing an open unsaved form. Handle unsupported APIs with a clear best-effort state. Do not add backup export or import.
